headline: Music/SFX were improved, title/menu visuals were overhauled, mobile tap scaling was fixed, auto-touch feedback was added, and the clean wholesome title art is live in production.

last_live_check.browser_visual_check: Passed on live custom domain at 1280x720. The clean wholesome title art and Phaser-rendered menu were visible with no duplicate baked menu.

untracked_files_left_alone: docs/Strategieen voor Geavanceerde Automatisering in Incrementele Games.md
working_tree_after_deploy.note: This handoff file itself was created after the production deploy and may be uncommitted unless explicitly committed later.

summary: Made the title/start-screen music more complex and less bare.
Improved procedural game tracks so they build with more layers and energy.
Investigated and addressed clipping/clicking at the starts of tracks and across gameplay music.
Improved SFX character across touch/regrow/upgrade/unlock/seed/milestone/blocked style cues.
Committed and shipped the audio work before the visual pass.
verification: Runtime was checked in browser during the session.
User accepted the direction and asked to commit/push/deploy.

summary: Cleaned up the start menu presentation after the user reported artifacts: a white blob behind the title, odd menu selection visuals, and small background errors above the selection box.
Moved title/menu rendering toward Phaser-drawn UI layers instead of relying on baked UI inside a background image.
Improved board/gameplay visuals enough that the user responded positively after local preview.
verification: Local visual preview was accepted by user.

completed_this_session.area: Mobile tap scaling bug and credits

commit.message: Fix mobile tap scaling and credit playtester

summary: Handled Discord feedback that fast tapping on mobile made tile sizes increase/decrease seemingly randomly.
Fixed the mobile tap/viewport scaling issue.
Added the reporting Discord user, TuloWodash, to playtester credits.
Added a reminder/TODO to bring back the cute title background later after the first visual replacement removed too much charm.

completed_this_session.area: Attempted return of old cute title art
summary: Tried restoring the original wholesome title-screen background.
This was wrong because public/assets/title-screen.png contains the old baked logo/menu plus translucent rectangle artifacts.
The result stacked the new Phaser UI on top of old baked UI, creating duplicate title/menu graphics.
The bad restore was reverted after user flagged it with a screenshot.
Important lesson: do not use public/assets/title-screen.png raw as a background unless it is cleaned or replaced.
verification: The bad version was visually identified by user.
The revert was committed, pushed, deployed, and production returned to the safer state.

summary: Added lightweight visuals so automation feels active while auto-touch systems are running.
Goal was to make players see more things happening without damaging framerate or optimization.
This was committed and deployed, then preserved through the later title-art revert.
Created real project assets from the clean wholesome preview art the user liked.
Added separate landscape and portrait background files.
Updated TitleScene to load both assets and switch to the portrait version when the viewport is phone-shaped.
Kept logo/title/menu as Phaser-rendered UI on top, so there is no old baked menu underneath.
Removed decorative title/foreground glow layers that created blob-like artifacts over the menu.

new_assets.notes: Clean landscape title art, cropped/upscaled from the clean preview the user preferred.
Phone portrait crop with the hiker and meadow visible behind the menu.

verification: Local desktop browser screenshot at 1280x720 passed.
Local mobile browser screenshot at 390x844 passed and selected the portrait asset.
Both new background assets returned 200 from production.

saved_art_archive.summary: Preserves the clean generated preview screenshot, the current live landscape/portrait title assets, alternate portrait crops, rejected inpaint experiments, and rejected reference screenshots.

current_title_screen_approach: Background art is now art only.
Title, subtitle, menu panel, menu labels, selectors, options, credits, and class selection remain code-rendered in Phaser.
do_not_repeat: Do not use public/assets/title-screen.png as a direct full-screen background. It contains old baked title text, old menu labels, and translucent rectangle artifacts.
Do not layer the new Phaser title/menu over a background that already has a title/menu baked into it.
Be careful with semi-transparent overlay glows on the title screen; they can read as visual bugs or blobs.
asset_quality_note: The final title background is clean and accepted, but it was derived from the clean preview screenshot rather than a pristine generated source file because the image generation output did not expose a reliable saved asset path.
If revisiting later, generate or paint a higher-resolution source asset with no text/UI/panels/artifacts and replace the two webp files.

user_feedback_captured.feedback: The game is fun but visuals were boring and the start menu had visual weirdness.
user_feedback_captured.result: Triggered the visual polish and title/menu pass.

user_feedback_captured.feedback: Circled title-menu artifacts: white blob behind title and odd translucent/background errors near the menu.
user_feedback_captured.result: Moved away from baked title/menu art and cleaned the overlay approach.

user_feedback_captured.feedback: Wait you made that? I thought it was an existing game. That's sick.
user_feedback_captured.result: Good external validation after visual polish.

user_feedback_captured.feedback: On mobile it trips when tapping fast; tile size increases/decreases seemingly randomly.
user_feedback_captured.result: Mobile tap scaling bug fixed and TuloWodash added to playtester credits.

user_feedback_captured.feedback: Automation running felt non-active; players need to see more things happening.
User liked the wholesome generated visuals and wanted the menu to work over them.
user_feedback_captured.result: Final clean responsive title art shipped.

explicit_user_preferences_and_constraint.preference: User likes the cute/wholesome title art direction.
explicit_user_preferences_and_constraint.actionable_note: Keep charm and coziness when polishing visuals; do not overcorrect into plain utility.

explicit_user_preferences_and_constraint.preference: User dislikes visual artifacts and stacked old/new UI.
explicit_user_preferences_and_constraint.actionable_note: Before shipping visual changes, screenshot-check desktop and mobile views in the actual browser.

explicit_user_preferences_and_constraint.preference: User wants richer music and SFX.
explicit_user_preferences_and_constraint.actionable_note: Further audio work should be judged by listening feel, not only technical build checks.
This was in the previous handoff and should remain respected.

explicit_user_preferences_and_constraint.preference: User is tired at this handoff point.
explicit_user_preferences_and_constraint.actionable_note: Start the next session with a brief recap and immediate next action, not a long interrogation.

latest_relevant_output: vite v8.0.16 building client environment for production

recommended_start_tomorrow: Run git status --short. Expect no tracked changes unless this handoff file is still uncommitted; unrelated docs/research files may still be untracked.
Open https://grasstouchingsimulator.com/ and quickly confirm the title screen still shows the clean wholesome art.
Ask the user what to focus on next: more visual polish, gameplay/automation feel, or another audio pass.
If touching the title art again, do a desktop and phone screenshot before deploying.
If improving title art quality later, replace the two title-wholesome webp files with true high-resolution clean art, not the old baked title-screen.png.

possible_next_tasks.notes: Current assets look good and are live, but are derived from a preview screenshot. A future pass can create pristine 16:9 and 9:16 source art.
Auto-touch visuals are in; continue making automation and progression feel alive without hurting framerate.
Music/SFX shipped, but subjective listening feedback should drive the next audio improvements.
TuloWodash was added as playtester after bug report. Keep adding playtesters if feedback comes in.

notes_for_next_codex: Use rg first for code search.
Do not revert unrelated files or untracked docs unless the user explicitly asks.
When deploying, stage only intended files, commit, push master, run npx vercel --prod --yes, then check the custom domain.
For browser visual checks, use the in-app browser skill and reset any temporary viewport override after testing.
The user responds well to proactive work, but visual changes need real screenshot verification because small artifacts matter here.
